description.zh: 新建的用户组的备注信息。最多支持500字符。
description.en: The description of the user group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh:
要新建用户组的堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a user group.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
要新建用户组的堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a user group.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh: 要新建的用户组的名称。最多支持128字符。
description.en: The name of the user group that you want to create. This name can be a up to 128 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于为堡垒机创建用户组。堡垒机管理员可使用本接口创建用户组，然后使用[AddUsersToGroup](~~204600~~)接口为该用户组批量添加用户。将用户添加到同一个用户组，可实现对堡垒机用户的统一授权和管理。

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Creates a user group for a bastion host as an administrator. After creating the group, use the [AddUsersToGroup](~~204600~~) operation to add multiple users at once, enabling centralized user authorization and management.

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-name group --comment comment --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateUserGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Comment comment --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --UserGroupName group --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
